SELECT EXISTS( SELECT 1 FROM chengke_crm.sys_user WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND lower(username) = lower(#{username}) AND (#{excludeUserId,jdbcType=OTHER} IS NULL OR id <> #{excludeUserId,jdbcType=OTHER}) )
SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, name, node_type AS nodeType, status, depth FROM chengke_crm.department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND id = #{departmentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL

SELECT c.descendant_id FROM chengke_crm.department_closure c JOIN chengke_crm.department d ON d.tenant_id = c.tenant_id AND d.id = c.descendant_id AND d.deleted_at IS NULL WHERE c.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND c.ancestor_id = #{ancestorId} AND (#{includeDescendants} = true OR c.distance = 0)

SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, name, node_type AS nodeType, status, depth FROM chengke_crm.department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY path_ids, sort_order, created_at, id

SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, name, node_type AS nodeType, status, depth FROM chengke_crm.department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND parent_id = #{parentId} AND deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY sort_order, created_at, id

SELECT id, parent_id AS parentId, name, node_type AS nodeType, status, depth FROM chengke_crm.department WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND deleted_at IS NULL AND name ILIKE concat('%', #{keyword}, '%')
SELECT id, name, code, status, built_in AS builtIn FROM chengke_crm.sys_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND status = 'active' ORDER BY name, id

SELECT u.id FROM chengke_crm.sys_user u JOIN chengke_crm.sys_role r ON r.tenant_id = u.tenant_id AND r.id = u.role_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND u.status = 'active' AND r.built_in = true AND r.code = 'super_admin' FOR UPDATE OF u
